name: Sampling Proportional to Transmittance
definition: A technique to sample distances proportional to transmittance $T(t)$ using weighted samples derived from delta/ratio trackers, avoiding the need for explicit normalization constant evaluation in the estimator.
summary: Sampling Proportional to Transmittance generates free-flight distances distributed by the transmittance function rather than the standard extinction-weighted distribution, enabling unbiased inverse volume rendering without explicit normalization.
